description: [WORD · door] Read a passage — a single verse, a range (John 3:16-18), or a whole chapter (John 3). The WEB by default; lang picks a held public-domain translation (es, fr, de, zh, he, la, ru, ar, ja, ko, …; an unknown lang lists what is held). The books beyond the 66 that the Catholic and Orthodox churches read (Tobit 4:15, Sirach 3:30, Psalm 151:1, Susanna 1) are read on their own layer, each with its edition, numbering and standing; edition picks eng-web (the World English Bible, the default) or engDRA (the Douay-Rheims 1899, in the Vulgate's numbering).

edition.description: the canon layers' edition, default eng-web

name: read_passage
